checks: Administrator completes actual email challenge and TOTP using an independent scoped identity
Unsigned packaged native Desktop completes real browser OTP and PKCE and opens its own customer support form
Native uncertain-write notice follows the current language without runtime details, generic retry advice or an extra submission
Native HTTP response loss and renderer reload recover the original customer grant without another authorization or deadline extension
Desktop creates a real customer-owned, explicitly scoped 15-minute grant without granting administrator permissions
Web uncertain-write notice switches language on the same operation and preserves the original recovery identity
A delayed customer receipt cannot repopulate grants or success notices after an actual in-app workspace switch
Web response loss and reload retrieve the original committed authorization and exact deadline without persisting the consent reason
A keyboard-submitted uncommitted request retries the identical key, reason, scope and deadline; a changed intent cannot create another grant
A failed Web read keeps the signed-in workspace and recovers on explicit refresh
Web creates and revokes an actual metadata-only grant; an empty project selection never means all projects
Actual Admin form creates a scoped read-only session with a permanent identity banner and private-task body exclusion
A delayed real response for task A cannot overwrite task B after the administrator changes selection
Switching sessions opens the newly selected real view while the previous view response is still held
Metadata revision polling clears an obsolete body before rereading, and actual HTML-like output remains inert text
An actual original-file quarantine removes both the opened result and its diagnostic body action
Actual 375/768/1024/1440 Admin layouts, Chinese dark view, native widths and keyboard form controls pass without Desktop rails or menus
Support pages retain working keyboard controls and no horizontal overflow at 200 percent text enlargement; native Desktop uses actual webContents zoom without visible rails
Actual server-clock expiry clears an opened authorized body without a worker or simulated clock
Native customer revocation is durable and clears the separately authenticated administrator view
Support reads and customer authorization create no extra tasks, holds, charges, provider calls or customer credentials; bodies stay out of browser storage
